problem: Micro-implementations and per-stage audits have become the critical path and are delaying the scientific objective.

policy.unit_of_work: A bundle is the smallest auditable unit. Internal coding, tests, diagnostics and commits are continuous work, not separate approval stages.
policy.audit_frequency: When the driver is Astra, omit Fable pre-bundle and Opus closure audits under astra_driver_exception. Otherwise retain one Opus closure audit and the existing sol backup rule. No audit pauses an internal step except for a safety or physics-failure stop condition.

astra_driver_exception.driver_responsibility: Assess design proportionality, final CF4 goal contribution, feasibility and mandatory/deferred scope; review code and results and record the closure judgment.
astra_driver_exception.precedence: Overrides external-audit requirements in project plans while Astra drives; earlier audit records remain historical. For other drivers, the ordinary audit policy applies unless the user directs otherwise.

policy.approval_frequency: User approval is requested only before entering the next bundle, not before each script, test, patch or diagnostic.

pre_bundle_design_audit.required_when: The active driver is not Astra; see astra_driver_exception.
pre_bundle_design_audit.timing: After the driver writes a bundle design and before that bundle begins execution; internal work already authorized inside the current bundle may continue only within its declared scope.
questions: Is the proposed measurement/verification burden proportionate, or is the project becoming over-instrumented relative to the density/velocity reconstruction goal?

How does this bundle advance the CF4-constrained z=0 local density/velocity posterior, the highest empirically supported constraint wavenumber, LCDM-consistent zoom ICs and forward reproduction of observed structures at <=0.3 cMpc/h numerical resolution? Distinguish numerical resolution from observational information. RT/feedback/dust is not an assigned CF4 project objective.
Is the plan feasible under the declared data, memory, GPU, wall-time and model contracts?
Which items are mandatory for the next scientific gate and which must be deferred?
pre_bundle_design_audit.decision: For non-Astra drivers, record Fable's advice and resolve mandatory changes. Astra performs the design assessment directly. Both require user approval before entering the next bundle.

storage_semantics.gpfs: shared POSIX storage mounted on login and compute nodes; treat it like /home for declared project artifacts
storage_semantics.gpfs_read_write: allowed only for explicitly declared inputs and new output directories under normal filesystem permissions

roles.driver: Plan, implement, execute, analyze, commit, report and await user approval at the next bundle boundary. Astra also performs the design assessment and closure review directly.
roles.claude_opus_5: Primary closure auditor for non-Astra drivers; skipped when Astra drives.
roles.gpt_5_6_sol: Backup only when an applicable Opus audit is unavailable or doubted; no automatic substitute for audits waived under the Astra exception.
roles.grok: Not an auditor in this workflow.
roles.fable: Pre-bundle design auditor for non-Astra drivers: assess over-measurement, final-goal contribution, feasibility and mandatory/deferred scope. Skipped when Astra drives.

non_stop_conditions: a small test failure that can be fixed in the same bundle
an audit CLI timeout without a physics or safety failure
a need to add a regression test or update a manifest within the declared bundle

bundles.scope: Q1/Q6/Q7 operator implementation, registry contracts, seven development fixtures, containment/error/resource measurements
bundles.deliverable: One consolidated operator viability dossier and one Opus closure audit
bundles.scientific_boundary: development-only; no posterior, IC, PM/HOP/RAMSES or 0.3 cMpc/h claim

bundles.scope: CF4 provenance/selection/covariance, independent truth mocks, low-k parent posterior, and data-driven constraint-frontier measurement
bundles.deliverable: One z=0 posterior/frontier dossier and one Opus closure audit
bundles.scientific_boundary: no high-k promotion or zoom selection before frontier gates

bundles.scope: Record-only closure of the active KF-DESIGN baseline binding, geometry-only bin manifest validation, and source-bound likelihood readiness gaps
bundles.deliverable: One local readiness dossier and one Opus closure audit
bundles.scientific_boundary: no catalog or external-artifact read, no mock truth opening, no posterior/frontier inference, no KF-EXPAND, IC, PM, HOP or RAMSES execution

bundles.scope: Use the source-bound GPFS artifacts and existing Phase-A/B/C records to repair the datum-bearing z=0 density-likelihood route after the Phase-C sampler/PMWD NO-GO
bundles.deliverable: One concise repair decision record; only the minimum implementation or execution needed to establish a stable development-mock z=0 posterior
bundles.scientific_boundary: z=0 density/velocity posterior development only; no actual CF4 posterior, parent promotion, high-k completion, IC, PM, HOP, RAMSES or 0.3 cMpc/h claim

bundles.scope: conditional high-k completion, q-corrected IC proposal, PM forward evolution, and z=0 density/velocity reproduction
bundles.deliverable: One IC-to-z=0 forward-validation dossier and one Opus closure audit
bundles.scientific_boundary: high-k is labelled conditional/prior-dominated until independent gates pass

bundles.scope: phase-consistent Lagrangian masks, HOP/RAMSES target validation, and <=0.3 cMpc/h numerical zoom hierarchy
bundles.deliverable: One zoom validation dossier and one Opus closure audit
bundles.scientific_boundary: no production run without B2 closure and explicit output/resource audit
